name: gizza-ai/http-request
summary: Make a full HTTP request and return status, headers, and body

tool.description: Make a full HTTP request to an http(s) URL: choose the method, set custom headers and query parameters, and send an optional request body. Returns the status (code + reason), the response headers, and the body (pretty-printed when it is JSON). Only public URLs are allowed — loopback and private addresses are blocked.

body.description: Optional raw request body. If you set a JSON content-type header, pass JSON text here as-is.

headers.description: Request headers as a name->value map.

query.description: Query parameters merged into the URL as a name->value map.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL to request.
